Join Musical_Preferences with Musical_Styles and use CASE statements to count occurrences of each style at PreferenceSeq 1, 2, and 3.

args.sql:
SELECT 
    s.StyleName AS Musical_Style,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 1 THEN 1 END) AS First_Preference_Count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 2 THEN 1 END) AS Second_Preference_Count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 3 THEN 1 END) AS Third_Preference_Count
FROM 
    entertainmentagency.main.Musical_Styles s
LEFT JOIN 
    entertainmentagency.main.Musical_Preferences mp ON s.StyleID = mp.StyleID
GROUP BY 
    s.StyleName
ORDER BY 
    s.StyleName;
